definitions.explanation: The line of descent within a family, including ancestors and descendants. Used to discuss hereditary traits, family history, or genealogy.

examples.japanese: この{家系|かけい}は{子孫|しそん}{繁栄|はんえい}を{願|ねが}って{建|た}てられた。
examples.english: This was built with hopes for the prosperity of the family's descendants.

examples.japanese: {家系図|かけいず}を{調|しら}べた。
{彼|かれ}の{家系|かけい}には{医者|いしゃ}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: There are many doctors in his family line.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{家系図|かけいず} (family tree; genealogy)
・{家系|かけい}ラーメン (Ie-kei ramen - a style of ramen from Yokohama)
・{名門|めいもん}の{家系|かけい} (distinguished family line)

NOTE: {家系|かけい}ラーメン refers to a style of thick, rich ramen that originated from the Yoshimura-ya shop in Yokohama, unrelated to 'family lineage.'
